raw_text: ALERT: BSF detected and engaged Pakistani drone near Amritsar on Punjab international border. Hexacopter shot down carrying suspected narcotics payload. This is the THIRD drone incursion this week. ड्रोन को गोली मारकर गिराया गया। Payload recovery underway. Anti-drone systems being deployed at forward posts.
clean_text: BSF shot down Pakistani hexacopter drone near Amritsar carrying narcotics. Third drone incursion this week on Punjab border. Anti-drone systems being deployed.
